claim: Milvus支持三种部署选项：Milvus Lite、Milvus Standalone和Milvus Distributed
quote: Milvus is a highly performant, scalable vector database. It supports use cases of a wide range of sizes, from demos running locally in Jupyter Notebooks to massive-scale Kubernetes clusters handling tens of billions of vectors. Currently, there are three Milvus deployment options: Milvus Lite, Milvus Standalone, and Milvus Distributed.

claim: Milvus Standalone是单机服务器部署，所有组件打包到单个Docker镜像中
quote: Milvus Standalone is a single-machine server deployment. All components of Milvus Standalone are packed into a single Docker image , making deployment convenient. If you have a production workload but prefer not to use Kubernetes, running Milvus Standalone on a single machine with sufficient memory is a good option. By default, Milvus Standalone runs Woodpecker (embedded) as its message queue, so there’s no separate messaging service to operate.

claim: Milvus Standalone比维护K8s集群需要少得多的DevOps工作
quote: Small-Scale Production Deployment For early-stage production, when the project is still seeking product-market fit and agility is more important than scalability, Milvus Standalone is the best choice. It can still scale up to 100M vectors given enough machine resource, while requiring much less DevOps than maintaining a K8s cluster.
